scope: Read-only archive-admission helper candidate for qualification-plan-v1 steps02/06/07/09/12; not an execution controller
trusted_inputs: Parent-supplied immutable owned seekable byte stream; parent forbids concurrent writers throughout inspection and later use.
Expected size/digest/algorithm and finite limits from separately reviewed trusted metadata, never archive contents.
Only ZIP stored/deflated and stdlib TAR recognition are proposed; compression/profile drift stops rather than broadening admission.
output: Whole-report inventory only after exact artifact identity, member checks and complete per-file reads. Parent must reject failure/exception; no partial inventory is an admission.
decisions: Use standard-library archive readers; no custom decompressor/parser or extractor.
Reject traversal, drive/ADS/UNC/backslash, reserved/ambiguous lexical paths, case/parent collisions, links/special/sparse/reparse members; do not normalize rejected names into acceptable ones.
No filesystem writes, destination handling, network, imports from inspected bytes, extraction or execution.
review_questions: Does the candidate implement the bounded read-only member/size/hash inventory under its explicit stable-stream precondition?
Do synthetic tests exercise real helper boundaries without copying implementation logic into expected results?
Are parser/resource/ownership/extraction limitations truthful and complete enough for presenting this subset only?
remaining_before_trial: Review this helper independently; this does not review or authorize a complete controller.
Prepare/review acquisition with exact trusted artifacts and redirect/size/hash controls, owned target/stream and filesystem containment/extraction.
Prepare/review retained-output reservations, actual free-space floor and owned process/environment/deadline/failure preservation with exact argument vectors.
Obtain exact runtime/source-build execution approval; require512MiB retained allowance plus1GiB floor before acquisition.
Review concrete build/full marker-extra closures before their respective installs, then trial results/notices before any adoption.
limits: No hard CPU/memory quota: stdlib ZIP metadata and TAR extension parsing can allocate before entry checks. Cooperative clock is checked between reads/entries only.
No hostile/mutable file-object or destination-filesystem safety proof. Lexical casefold inventory is not Windows alias/reparse/8.3 containment enforcement.
Existing interpreter3.14.5 only; actual3.15 behavior and official artifact contents remain unexecuted.
